posts.title: Fileless ELF Execution via O_TMPFILE
posts.description: Hello guys! So today I want to show a way to execute an ELF payload that never touches disk as a named file. No memfd_create , no /memfd: prefix anywhere in telemetry. The trick is O_TMPFILE combined with execveat(AT_EMPTY_PATH) , and it works on any kernel since 3.19.
